scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,desktop "yarn workspace web dev" "yarn workspace desktop dev"
scripts.dev:browser: concurrently -k -n web,server "yarn workspace web dev" "yarn workspace desktop dev:server"
scripts.build: yarn workspace web build && yarn workspace desktop build
scripts.start: yarn build && yarn workspace desktop start
scripts.server: yarn workspace desktop build:main && yarn workspace desktop server
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace web typecheck && yarn workspace desktop typecheck
